_comment: Operator-curated minimum slab counts per bank/variant for the drift-detection retry path (lib/tier-router.js#checkQuality, run-discovery.js).  Image-baked configuration: ships in the container, never round-trips through blob storage.  See data/bank-domains.json for runtime-mutated per-bank state (that file is cloud-synced; this one is not).  Threshold (0.8) is applied at check time by tier-router; values here are raw expected counts from operator-validated runs.
